integrity: A precise finite claim supported by an exact factor-extraction lemma, subgroup reduction and executable standard-library checks; no independent audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers only even lengths two through eight for the Thue–Morse word. The full recent primary manuscript remained inaccessible, leaving residual priority risk. Computation is exhaustive only after the proven finite reductions.
title: The first even-length recovery of near-maximal group complexity in the Thue–Morse word
